scope_rule: Only draft rows whose source_id starts with 'covariance/' AND whose case_plan_annex is docs/dev-log/core070/covariance-required-case-plan.json. Rows whose annex is slopes-required-case-plan.json or structured-required-case-plan.json belong to other areas' batches and are out of scope here.
run_style_note: Every case in this batch checks the R (gllvmTMB) side of a formula-grammar admission fact: gllvmTMB:::parse_multi_formula(gllvmTMB:::desugar_brms_sugar(<formula>)) evaluated against a fixed, deterministic fixture environment, with the resulting covstructs list compared field-by-field against the frozen expectation below. None of these 9 executable cases has a Julia-side grammar entry point to compare against yet (verified by grep over src/formula.jl at reference_commit finding no animal_latent/meta_V/meta_known_V/phylo_latent/phylo_dep/latent grammar keywords); the julia_surface field on each case records that gap verbatim from the adversarially-verified draft spec so the obligation stays visible rather than silently discharged. This batch produces retained R-side oracle evidence only -- it does not claim Julia parity.

fixture.A: 4x4 symmetric positive-definite matrix, dimnames = species_levels, hand-specified constant (see tools/core070_covariance_batch.R:FIXTURE_A) so the run is exactly reproducible without RNG
fixture.V: length-4 strictly positive numeric vector named by species_levels (see tools/core070_covariance_batch.R:FIXTURE_V)
fixture.fixture_note: No response data or model fit is involved in this batch; only formula objects are constructed and parsed. species/A/V exist solely so the formulas' in-keyword arguments (species=, A=, V=) resolve to real R objects when parse_covstruct_call() evaluates them in the formula's environment.

comparands_convention: Structural equality only (kind string, presence/absence of named extra fields, and where noted, identical() to a fixture object or to a quoted language symbol). No floating-point comparands or numeric tolerances apply to any case in this batch -- these are formula-grammar admission facts, not model fits.

failure_action: Retain the complete attempt. A parse failure, an unexpected covstructs shape, or a negative control that fails to raise are all recorded verbatim in the results JSON, never silently dropped or downgraded to a pass.
claim_boundary: Passing this batch establishes that gllvmTMB's frozen R formula grammar produces the documented covstructs shape for nine specific covariance-area terms, and that two guard conditions still abort as documented. It does NOT establish Julia parity for any of these terms -- no Julia-side formula grammar or model exists yet for any case in this batch, which is why every executable case here is R-only. The tenth case (native Julia model equivalence for the folded/auto-unique animal-model term) is left an open obligation as SPEC_DEFECT rather than claimed.
